personalities.name: You’re...The Agent 🍸
personalities.description: You take charge and make big things look easy — set the goal and let it run. Your cocktail: The Agent (gin, bergamot, fig, soda), a clean, effortless pour that does the work for you. Like Cresta’s AI Agent, it handles the busywork so you can savor what matters.

personalities.name: You’re...The Assist 🥃
personalities.description: You read the moment and give everything around you a boost. Your cocktail: The Assist (bourbon, lemon, tamarind, maple), a balanced blend that lifts every flavor it touches. Like Cresta’s real-time guidance, you make everyone better in the moment.

personalities.name: You’re...The Decoder 🌵
personalities.description: You notice what others miss and read between the lines. Your cocktail: Decoder (mezcal, lime, prickly pear, agave), a layered, smoky pour that reveals more with every sip. Like Cresta’s conversation intelligence, you turn subtle cues into sharp insight.

questions.label: Night One
questions.text: It’s night one in a new city — what’s your move?

answers.content: Rooftop bar, skyline, all the energy
Wander with no plan and see what you find
Track down the spot someone you trust swore by

questions.label: Packing Style
questions.text: How do you pack for a trip?

answers.content: Grab the essentials and wing it
Leave room for whatever the trip brings
Make a list for everything, nothing is forgotten
